from app.dependencies import LeaseStore
from app.service import render

# Test 1: Immediate rendering (defer=False)
store = LeaseStore({'slot': 'hello'})
result = render(store, 'slot', lambda value: f'[{value}]')
print(f'Immediate: {result}')

# Test 2: Deferred rendering (defer=True)
callback = render(store, 'slot', lambda value: f'[{value}]', defer=True)
print(f'Callback is callable: {callable(callback)}')
result = callback()
print(f'Deferred result: {result}')
assert result == '[hello]', f'Expected [hello], got {result}'

print('All tests passed!')
